sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If
you purchase securities in the offering, you will experience immediate dilution to the extent of the difference between the effective
offering price per share of $6.122 per share of common stock and our as-adjusted net tangible book value per share immediately after
the offering. Net tangible book value per share is equal to the amount of our total tangible assets, less total liabilities, divided
by the number of outstanding shares of our common stock. As of June 30, 2026, our net tangible book value was approximately $1.68
million, or approximately $3.71 per share. Our
pro forma net tangible book value as of June 30, 2026, was approximately $5.2 million or $4.44 per share of common stock, based upon
1,166,625 shares of common stock outstanding as of October 6, 2026. Pro forma net tangible book value represents net tangible book value
